key_operational_facts: launcHER's launch flow reboots the IOP in initModules; ps2link dies ~1 second in. All launcHER runs therefore end as rig 'hang'/'no_result' with stdout stopping at 'path: ...'. That signature is expected and is NOT a failure indicator.
All launcHER-side output after the reset is screen-only (DPRINTF/boot_trace channel). The console screen (user screenshots) is the launcHER-phase evidence channel.
A wedged console (black/unresponsive after a failed or hung game run) requires a physical power-cycle; the rig's loader restart cannot recover it. Runs 132/133 and 138 required one.
Sony-phase behavior is observable via popfs's event trace at <disc0-device>:popfs_trace.log (written to the backing store, readable by a later probe run).
